lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 004: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: prd.json:96 (US-002 AC2 oracle) is still unfixed and implementer-protected (see US-R1-003's openQuestion, unresolved): an orchestrator/operator session needs to add --exclude='_generated.ts' to that oracle string directly, since prd.json edits are hard-blocked for implementer sessions.

US-R1-005 (verified-dispatch.ts's @cam_label uses the raw sentinel phase string, e.g. 'implementer-timeout', which isSessionStale doesn't recognize as a worker label) is still open in prd.json for a future story.
nextStoryContext: Addressed the CAM-433 round-1 WARNING at src/supervisor/worker-argv.ts:16 (US-R1-004): corrected the stale 'Pure function; no spawning, no file I/O' / 'pure functions, no I/O' / 'is a pure function (no I/O)' module-header design-decision bullets in worker-argv.ts, plan-argv.ts, and review.ts, which contradicted the fact that ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv (backend-adapter.ts) writes the task prompt to a per-dispatch file on disk (reaping prior siblings) as a side effect of building the argv string. Also corrected the stale 'single-quote-escaped' claim and the literal '<task>'/'<taskPrompt>' return-shape docstring examples on all 6 exported builder functions (buildImplementerWorkerArgv, buildPlannerWorkerArgv, buildAuditorWorkerArgv, buildReviewerWorkerArgv) in the same 3 files, since those function-level docstrings carried the identical staleness the finding called out at the module-header level (same file, same defect class, left unaddressed would just relocate the misleading claim). No production behavior changed: comment-only fix. Raised src/supervisor/review.ts's file-size ceiling 782->789 (dated _ref note added) to cover the corrected docstrings. Quality gates: typecheck ok, 5663 tests pass / 0 fail, full `bun run check:all` spine green (typecheck, test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps). New patterns.md bullet added documenting that a module-header 'Design decisions' block is a separate contract from per-field JSDoc and both need sweeping together. Remaining review round 1 findings still open in prd.json for future stories: US-R1-005 (verified-dispatch.ts's @cam_label staleness, see openQuestions above).
